question: How does the nāda-suṣumnā support pervade and exit the universe?
premises: The support of nāda and suṣumnā pierces this entire universe.
It goes out below by the downward śakti.
It goes out above from the crown by the upward śakti.
inference: The nāda-suṣumnā axis permeates the whole cosmos and extends beyond it in both directions.
plain_english: The support of nāda and suṣumnā pierces this entire universe; it goes out below by the downward power and above from the crown by the upward power.
